steps.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. ONE original standalone landscape 3:2 editorial photograph, not collage. Two fictional adult friends at a quiet outdoor terracotta athletics track, a short-haired East Asian woman in a mustard oversized T-shirt and navy trousers, and a Black adult man with close-cropped hair in teal sweatshirt and cream trousers. Both full body, standing side by side relaxed, shoes fully visible with generous margin. Pale concrete stadium tiers and forest-green seats as simple repeating background anchors, blue sky. Warm afternoon sun, human natural anatomy, realistic fabric and skin. Tasteful lifestyle campaign photograph. No real people references, no celebrities, no brands, no logos, no text, no watermark. Source photograph only, no illustration panel.

Use case: style-transfer. Supplied image is sole source/identity reference. Follow geometric-flat-twin-poster. One 3:4 portrait diptych, two independently enclosed horizontal windows stacked, equal size, hard horizontal ivory separator and elegant ivory margin with dark thin keylines. Landscape source with two full-body subjects favors stacked composition over narrow side-by-side. Upper window preserves reference photograph, exact two people, clothes, pose, position, footwear and stadium scene. Lower reinterprets EXACT same composition in strong modernist GEOMETRIC FLAT painted forms: bodies simplified to rectangles/trapezoids, oval face shapes, large dark hair shapes, wedge limbs, stadium seats merged into rhythmic green blocks. Use minimal shapes with maximum recognizability, flattened pictorial space, large mustard, teal, navy, cream and terracotta color planes, matte gouache texture, slightly hand cut irregular edges. Not a filter, not outlining, not cartoon, no complex shading or digital gradients. Preserve full heads, hands, shoes and scene anchors in both. No cross-frame elements, no typography, no logos.
